gameDescriptionHtml:
Be the last to brake in EA SPORTS F1 23, the official video game of the 2023 FIA Formula One World Championship.

BRAKING POINT 2 – A new chapter in the thrilling “Braking Point” story mode delivers high-speed drama and heated rivalries.
ENHANCED AUTHENTICITY – Race wheel-to-wheel at new Las Vegas and Qatar circuits. New Red Flags add an authentic strategic element, and the 35% Race Distance feature delivers more action and excitement.
F2 2023 SEASON UPDATE – The ultimate training ground for F1 is now updated with the latest 2023 Season content, including the new cars and driver lineups across the paddock.
F1 WORLD – The all-new F1 World is your new hub for a variety of daily, weekly, and ever-changing seasonal content and events with an all-new Tech Level progression system for your personalized tour through Formula 18. Earn upgrades and spend time developing your F1 World car to be faster and more powerful as you progress. F1 World also introduces the revamped ranked multiplayer mode with a new division-based ranking system, F1 23’s Esports series, and a new Goals system that makes Podium Pass progress more efficiently. As you complete challenges on your F1 World journey, commemorate your progress with a new Compendium, which is your virtual sticker album that celebrates everything to do with Formula 1, past and present.
CROSS-PLAY – Play together and compete in split-screen or in the expanded cross-platform multiplayer.

Game Features

  • RAYTRACING – Immerse yourself deeper into your F1 experience with Raytraced visuals available in Race.
  • CUSTOM GRAPHIC SETTINGS – Fully optimize your playing experience.
  • EYE TRACKING SUPPORT – Become one with your F1 Car – track your eye movements when you’re behind the wheel to improve performance
  • VIRTUAL REALITY – Exclusive to PC. Feel the drama of the race from right inside the cockpit.
  • CONTROL SUPPORT – Extensive support for controllers, wheels, pedals, and custom hardware.
  • HIGHLIGHTS & REPLAYS – Export reels to video files, save full replays and even share them with friends.
  • CUSTOM RACE SETUPS – Use the Steam workshop feature to find and download balanced setups for every Grand Prix by using custom setups created by the community.

Included DLCs (only offline components):

  • Preorder Consumable
  • Deluxe Content
  • Deluxe Preorder Content
  • Deluxe Early Preorder Content
  • Champions Bumper Pack
  • Champions Upgrade
  • Early Pre-Order Livery Pack
  • F1 23 Late Deluxe Content
